tickets.title: Prepare updated funds-flow schedule
tickets.text: Prepare an updated funds-flow schedule for Julian Maplesprocket's sale of his 78 percent interest in Buttonwood Balloon Components to Copper Firefly Systems, separating gross consideration of approximately $20.6 million, the $2.2 million escrow holdback, the $1.5 million preferred-equity rollover, tax reserves, and transaction fees.
tickets.evidence: An updated funds-flow schedule is needed to separate gross consideration, holdbacks, rollover equity, tax reserves, and transaction fees by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Obtain equity ledger and option-cancellation records
tickets.text: Obtain the missing transaction records for Julian Maplesprocket's Buttonwood Balloon Components sale: the final capitalization table, option-cancellation records, and manager equity acknowledgments needed to confirm his sale proceeds and retained obligations.
tickets.evidence: the draft transaction folder does not include the final capitalization table, option-cancellation records, or manager equity acknowledgments needed to confirm Julian’s sale proceeds and retained obligations, so those equity ledger and option-cancellation records are needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare sale-liquidity staging plan
tickets.text: Prepare a plan for Julian Maplesprocket showing how incoming business-sale cash from the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale to Copper Firefly Systems is separated among immediate household reserves, estimated tax reserves, renovation funds, debt decisions, and staged investment tranches.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-liquidity staging plan by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Prepare preferred-equity rollover review
tickets.text: Prepare a plain-language financial review for Julian Maplesprocket of the proposed $1.5 million rollover into Copper Firefly Systems preferred equity, covering liquidity limits, dividend terms, redemption rights, and concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that preferred-equity rollover review by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare CPA sale-tax projection package
tickets.text: Prepare a coordinated tax estimate package for CPA Alma Dewspindle at Silver Marmot Tax Partners covering Julian Maplesprocket's Buttonwood Balloon Components sale: federal and Oregon tax, basis, installment-payment assumptions, escrow taxation, and shareholder note treatment, before he makes large cash-allocation decisions.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the CPA sale-tax projection package by 2025-01-07.

tickets.title: Model shareholder note payoff treatment
tickets.text: Model the payoff treatment of the approximately $380,000 shareholder note owed to Julian Maplesprocket by Buttonwood Balloon Components, showing it separately from equity proceeds so the advisory team and CPA Alma Dewspindle can distinguish repayment cash from taxable sale consideration assumptions.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to model the shareholder note payoff treatment by 2025-01-08.

tickets.title: Resolve retention bonus pool variance
tickets.text: Clarify with Copper Firefly Systems the difference between the buyer's schedule and board materials for the employee retention bonus pool connected to the Buttonwood Balloon Components transaction, which could affect Julian Maplesprocket's net proceeds and working-capital adjustments.
tickets.evidence: Clarification of the retention bonus pool variance is needed by 2025-01-06.

tickets.title: Prepare escrow holdback reserve analysis
tickets.text: Prepare a separate reserve scenario for Julian Maplesprocket's liquidity plan that excludes escrow release proceeds, since the draft transaction terms show he may not receive the full $2.2 million escrowed amount for an extended period.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the escrow holdback reserve analysis by 2025-01-13.

tickets.title: Verify incoming-wire capacity at Teacup Comet Bank
tickets.text: Verify Teacup Comet Bank's receiving-bank process and incoming-wire capacity for Julian Maplesprocket's expected sale proceeds before funds are sent, since the bank previously held a large inbound wire for manual review.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to verify incoming-wire capacity and receiving instructions by 2025-01-02.

tickets.title: Obtain final consulting agreement economics
tickets.text: Obtain the final consulting agreement economics for Julian Maplesprocket's post-closing involvement with Copper Firefly Systems, including compensation, expense reimbursement, termination, and noncompete interaction terms that affect his post-sale income forecast.
tickets.evidence: Final consulting agreement economics are needed by 2025-01-09.

tickets.title: Prepare post-sale investment policy
tickets.text: Prepare a written allocation framework for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket reflecting staged deployment of sale liquidity, cash comfort of at least 18 months of household expenses, tax exposure, and fossil-fuel screening preferences, since Julian does not want to invest the entire transaction liquidity immediately after closing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the post-sale investment policy by 2025-01-22.

tickets.title: Prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling
tickets.text: Model Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's possible $900,000 to $1.2 million Portland residence renovation, the $820,000 Portland mortgage at 3.1 percent, the $310,000 lake-cabin mortgage, and their desired liquidity floor before deciding how much sale cash can be committed to property spending.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare renovation and mortgage reserve modeling by 2025-01-16.

tickets.title: Review insurance transition after business sale
tickets.text: Review the insurance transition for Julian and Priya Maplesprocket after the Buttonwood Balloon Components sale, covering Julian's changed reliance on business income, the company-owned key-person policy, disability coverage assumptions, the $5 million umbrella exposure, and personal-liability concerns once the transaction becomes public.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to review the insurance transition after the business sale by 2025-01-15.

tickets.title: Complete estate liquidity and fiduciary review
tickets.text: Complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review of Julian and Priya Maplesprocket's 2016 estate plan, which names Priya as primary fiduciary and Oren Maplesprocket as successor, addressing fiduciary roles, trust funding assumptions, privacy, and whether the plan still matches current family circumstances given the anticipated liquidity increase.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to complete an estate liquidity and fiduciary review by 2025-01-17.

tickets.title: Collect residency and sourcing support file
tickets.text: Collect a residency and sourcing support file for CPA Alma Dewspindle at Silver Marmot Tax Partners' sale-year tax analysis, using Julian Maplesprocket's travel calendar, his 52 Oregon-outside workdays in 2024, and his Washington short-term apartment records.
tickets.evidence: Julian’s travel calendar, Oregon workdays, and Washington apartment records create a concrete need for a residency and sourcing support file for the CPA’s sale-year tax analysis by 2025-01-10.

tickets.title: Prepare charitable funding structure comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of charitable funding amounts and timing for Julian Maplesprocket, using the family's usual approximately $75,000 per year giving level, possible appreciated securities including the low-basis Marzipan Meadow Automation shares, and potential business-sale liquidity for a donor-advised structure or similar vehicle.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the charitable funding structure comparison by 2025-01-14.
